# Hacker News

> A tech community news aggregator and discussion forum where developers, founders, and tech enthusiasts discover, share, and debate the latest in technology, startups, and programming.

Hacker News is one of the internet's most influential tech communities, featuring real-time news feeds, community-driven submissions, job listings, and discussion forums. The platform emphasizes substantive technical discussion and discovery of novel ideas in computing and entrepreneurship.

## Main Feeds

- [Hacker News Homepage](https://news.ycombinator.com): Hacker News homepage - tech community news aggregator and discussion forum
- [News Feed](https://news.ycombinator.com/news): Hacker News main news feed with community submissions and discussions
- [Newest Links](https://news.ycombinator.com/newest): Real-time feed of newest submitted links on Hacker News
- [New Comments](https://news.ycombinator.com/newcomments): Real-time feed of newest community comments and discussions
- [Daily Front Page Archive](https://news.ycombinator.com/front): Daily front page archive view of Hacker News stories

## Community Sections

- [Ask HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/ask): Ask HN - community questions and discussion forum section
- [Show HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/show): Show HN - community projects and products showcase section
- [Jobs](https://news.ycombinator.com/jobs): Hacker News job board for tech careers and startup hiring

## Navigation & Discovery

- [Lists](https://news.ycombinator.com/lists): Navigation lists and curated collections of Hacker News features
- [User Submissions](https://news.ycombinator.com/from): User submissions filter and navigation for Hacker News content

## Guidelines & Policies

- [Community Guidelines](https://news.ycombinator.com/newsguidelines.html): Community guidelines and content policy for Hacker News
- [FAQ](https://news.ycombinator.com/newsfaq.html): FAQ covering ranking, karma system, and moderation on Hacker News
- [Security Policy](https://news.ycombinator.com/security.html): Security disclosure and vulnerability reporting policy for Hacker News
